Voluntary Wearing of Face Masks in Indoor and Outdoor Spaces.
The wearing of face masks in indoor and outdoor settings shall be voluntary except in
the following settings:
a. Healthcare facilities, including, but not limited to, clinics, hospitals,
laboratories, nursing homes and dialysis clinics;
b. Medical transport vehicles, such as ambulance and paramedic rescue
vehicles; and
c. Public transportation by land, air or sea.
Mask wearing is still encouraged for the:
b. Individuals with comorbidities;
c. Immunocompromised individuals;
d. Pregnant women;
e. Unvaccinated individuals; and
. Symptomatic individuals.

Minimum Public Health Standards. The minimum public health
standards (MPHS) to effectively prevent and minimize the spread of COVID-19 in the
country shall continue to be implemented consistent with the principles of shared
accountability, evidence-based decision-making, socioeconomic equity and
rights-based approach.
The DOH is directed to continuously update the MPHS guidelines in accordance
with this Order. The general public, in compliance with the MPHS, is hereby enjoined
to exercise diligence in carrying out health protocols, such as the practice of good
hygiene, frequent hand-washing, observance of physical distancing, and maintenance
of good ventilation especially in indoor settings.
2

Vaccination and Booster Coverage. All local government units
(LUs) are directed to submit regular reports on their vaccination status to the
Department of Health. Provinces, highly-urbanized cities, independent component
cities and municipalities which are currently at low risk classification, but at Alert Level
2 status because of failure to meet vaccination targets to warrant de-escalation, are
highly encouraged to undertake efforts to further expand their vaccination and booster

Assistance and Cooperation of Agencies and LGUs. All
departments, agencies and instrumentalities of the government, including state
universities and colleges, government-owned or -controlled corporations, and
government financial institutions, and LGUs are directed to render full assistance to
and cooperation with the ATF for the effective and orderly implementation of this

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is declared to be
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected shall
remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. EO No. 3 (s. 2022) is hereby repealed. All other orders, rules
and regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with the provisions of this
Order are hereby repealed, modified or amended accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
